name: Sheraton Tel Aviv
positioning: Officially Sheraton Grand Tel Aviv, a sea-view hotel whose suites and sea-view rooms look out over the Mediterranean, with an 18th-floor Club Lounge facing the sea
best_for: Travelers who want a room or suite with a balcony and Mediterranean views
Guests who value Club Lounge access with breakfast, evening dishes and drinks

facts.text: Sea view rooms include a balcony and views of the Mediterranean.
The hotel's suites are designed with modern amenities.
Junior Suites offer extra room for relaxation.
Club Level rooms provide exclusive access and enhanced amenities.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary breakfast, all-day hors d'oeuvres, live cooking, evening warm and cold dishes and beverages including alcohol.
The Sheraton Grand Club Lounge serves a dairy breakfast, dinner, drinks and cocktails.
Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the hotel.

highlights.text: Suites have a view of the deep blue Mediterranean and its white sandy beaches.
Sea view rooms include a balcony and views of the Mediterranean.
The Club Lounge is on the 18th floor, with views of the Mediterranean Sea.

considerations.text: Smoking is prohibited in all hotel rooms, balconies and public areas.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban location has high foot traffic in the surrounding area.
